reason: Fixes TestControllerSyncPool flake first reported on #136641; slices reusing names (index-based naming) race MutationCache; completes ineffective fix #137911.
Kind/bug: re-adds stubs 'after #122373' because make 'explodes on darwin'; repairs non-Linux build break caused by linux build tags.
Says it 'fixed a typo in previous refactor (#115693)' in node_shutdown_linux_test.go, alongside timeout bump for flake.
#92784's e2e pod-delete change broke tests and was reverted; this relocates wait logic so its ephemeral tests stop failing (#93321).
#119709 raised fake server timeout +1ms to +10ms; flake persisted, second bumps to +30ms. Pre-existing flake, earlier fix insufficient.
Fixes gated-pod nodeAffinity update rejected when affinity nil, a bug in mutable scheduling directives validation added by #116161 (same validation.go).
'Fix in #123381 was not enough'; NFS vers=4.1 issue pre-existed; first PR was an incomplete fix, not the cause.
'Since #133940 removed [Serial]... suite runs in parallel HA jobs... failed in 10 of 15 runs'; failures caused by first PR's change.
'Handles a missed PVC minimum size change in #74764'; failover test failed from external GCE size change, first PR was incomplete.
'Introduced in a large-ish change to add reference counting: #80091'; refcounter errors without volumeDevices dir.
Error logging 'significantly increased since the aggregated discovery change... #113599'; release note: fixes 1.26 regression.
Replicates Linux GCS Authorization-header change (#74142) for Windows scripts; extension, not a fix.
'Follow up on #104844'; forceful connection closing dates from #63492, not caused by #104844.
Fixes data race in testShareResourceClaimSequentially in resourceclaim_test.go, the test added by #135820.
Full revert of #78463: 'flag was introduced without parsing the neg annotation'.
Kind/regression: restores conformance image build for cross/cross-in-a-container, disabled by #99386 Makefile change.
Kind/regression: resource version tracking added 'since #125675' wrongly declares Endpoints stale; fixes endpoints_controller.go.
Helm generator 'not read at all' before kubectl v1.21 (kustomize v4.0.5 via #98946); upgrade mitigates the security concern.
'Fix bugs in CPUManager distribute NUMA policy introduced for 1.23 in #105631'.
Kind/regression, 'Follow up to #93912': restores stackdriver agent support that #93912 replaced with fluentbit.
States #94115 does not reproduce the bug; the bug was first introduced by #96495.
Re-application of reverted #133167 with an extra test fix: 'See #133167, which was reverted due to a failing test'.
Reverts #139602's resourceVersion patches; issue #140098 flake confirmed caused by #139602 ('It looks like #139602 is the cause').
Agnhost bump in #127136 brought new iperf2 with new output fields, 'breaking the parser'; e2e failing on sig-network.
#103539 broke kubemark-500 (APF latency); wojtek-t: 'I opened #105647 to disable that logic'.
Fixes underlying smd issue #82042 enabling revert of workaround #87196; does not fix a defect caused by #87196.
#74686 cited only as 'A similar related case' of trailing-dot validation relaxation.
'Fixes a bug introduced in #88699' with reused meta/update vars in azure_vmss.go closures.
'#84014 broke the order of node evaluation in the scheduler across scheduling cycles'.
Mainly follow-up of #97979, but fixes kubelet panic in validPrimaryIP parsing loop that #97979 added in kubelet_pods.go.
#79529 'missed making the same change for detach'; short 10s detach timeout pre-existed.
'Filtered dialer introduced in 1.20 in #91785... does not correctly wire the args'; regression fix in pkg/proxy/util/utils.go.
Addon-manager legacy base image build failure; just aligns with #127166's base image, not caused by it.
Replaces deprecated grpc.WithDialer elsewhere; #83595 only xref as similar cleanup.
Autoscaler lacked apps/v1 support (crashloop seen pre-merge); #80536 only referenced, no evidence the Calico upgrade caused it.
'Apply the same style of fix as #87913 but for HTTP methods too'; extends fix, not repairing it.
Breakage introduced by #131534; #129826 mentioned only as earlier fix that got reverted by #131534.
Second says unit test added in #97172 decodes full swagger, ~12s under race; kind/flake speedup of that test.
"In #108080 we missed locking the new incomingBlock in blockQueue resulting in a race"; fixes mux.go.
First PR mentioned only as rebase dependency; issue #134100 bug not attributed to #133706.
"This is a regression, caused by adding #132058 in 1.34"; fixes deadlock in dra_plugin_manager.go.
"#130161 removed that flag... When passing it now, kubelet fails to come up"; fixes local-up-cluster.sh.
Fixes duplicate validation errors in topology validation added by #72046, per review thread on #72046; kind/bug.
"one of my previous PR (#114373) introduced a flaky test"; fixes TestGeneratePodSandboxConfig.
Second is the planned follow-up using the new /envvar endpoint; hostname-override test problem predates first PR.
"once I revert #108569, the error disappears"; release note: "Fix a 1.24 regression" in store.go.
"Reverts the IP allocator portions of #83422"; fixes v1.17.0 regression in service-cluster-ip-range handling.
Extends dangling-volume mechanism to untracked nodes; problem pre-existed, follow-up rather than defect introduced by #96224.
"#109946 introduced Restricted policy for some of the pod tests. This broke" Windows e2e; fixes utils.go.
"#67768 accidentally removed population of the ClientCA" in delegating auth; restores it.
Companion PRs: "Together with #64654 fixes #51457"; adds error handling in generated clients.
Second builds on first's PLEG cleanup to add on-demand per-pod relist; no defect repaired.
Makes new PSA check from #125271 honor emulation version; kind/bug, release-blocker, called stopgap to fix CI.
First PR mentioned as blocker for raw block fix ("We are blocked on #74026"); unrelated defect.
Revert of #86173 to fix regression #90074 with --local/--dry-run when no kubeconfig present.
Another Windows unit-test fix (gitattributes) proposed in #110263 review; CRLF problem predates first PR.
First PR already reverted; second is "a robust version of #76243" i.e. re-application with fix.
Lowers SSA enablement; #86015 mentioned as possible flake cause already mitigated elsewhere.
"#119537 ... has brought about a bug" where --attach skips attachFunc init; 1.29.0 regression.
"Changes around InPlacePodVerticalScaling feature (#128266) caused the EventHandlingPodUpdate to fail constantly".
"With #64976 GetGenericArchImage was used for generating the CoreDNS image path. This generated incorrect image".
PR page: "issue seemed to have been introduced in #118764"; fixes memory.swap.max startup regression in 1.28.
"Fix for bug i introduced in #130476"; wrong matcher BeEmpty replaced with BeNil.
"Fix kube-proxy implementation of Topology Aware Hints, implemented in #99522"; regression in 1.21.
Fixes version propagation so APILifecycle applies to CRDs; author calls it "an oversight in the original PR" #99840.
Both address go1.18 verify failures; second fixes root cause, not a defect from first PR.
"after this PR #86173 is merged, it breaks the original condition"; kubectl version without config.
"fix #103076. A fault of mine, the configuration file content and path are not correctly distinguished".
Follow-up feature limiting lease objects, building on #97480 metric; no defect repaired.
Nil-metadata check in resource allocation is pre-existing/potential issue raised in #77498 review; not a defect from it.
Bumps e2e manifest to agnhost 2.39 to ship #110212's fix; regression came from #110174.
"In #121538 the command for notTerminate job behavior was modified" breaking upgrade job; kind/regression.
Second says availableOnNodes omission: "#137647 didn't need it but it should have been added in #137897".
Completes bash 4.3 unbound-variable fix of #77910 for remaining variables; problem predates first PR.
Device plugin e2e test 'permafailing roughly since #127506', which bundled the #120661 change; second PR fixes the failing test.
Independent Go bump to 1.11.3 for CVE; 'in the same vein as #70665', no defect from first PR.
'PR #77595 introduced the field CSINodeInformer... not initialized in all places'; second PR adds missing initialization.
Revert of first PR; 'Fix a 1.27 regression that custom PreEnqueue plugins aren't executed' through backoffQ.
Second PR adds e2e tests covering changes in #72687; no defect repaired.
'Fix a regression from #131801 - allocation should be skipped if admission fails'; edits allocation_manager.go.
'#134461 hardcoded the containerd/runc version for Ubuntu but it's evaluated when OS is not Ubuntu'; fixes broken GCE jobs.
Same class of logging bug in a different component (AttachedVolume); #115950 cited only as reference.
'#73409 made an erroneous fix... return was omitted'; second PR adds the missing return in config.go.
Kind/regression; ClaimTimeout became 0s after #111034 bumped Azure timeouts without defaults; follow-up sets defaults first in in_tree.go.
Follow-up promoting image tag to pick up #134164 changes; not repairing a defect from it.
'Because I setup watch mechanism in #72045, assumed cache will be overridden'; fixes resulting flaky TestBindAPIUpdate.
#71192 commit raised local openapi resync to once per second, flooding logs; second PR bumps log verbosity to fix.
'When adding the new readyz handler (#110174) we forgot to handle SIGTERM without shutdown delay', process hangs; kind/regression.
Changelog cleanup removing entry for reverted #112127; not repairing a defect introduced by its code.
Test-only PR: 'DeleteCollection was actually fixed... in #105606. Here I'm only adding test'.
Post-merge review of #119341 flagged raw-error behavior change and over-broad metric skipping; second PR reworks those dispatcher changes, 'Fixes #119341'.
recordPluginMetrics was never copied in Clone before #108724; first PR only the review context for a pre-existing bug.
'With #130573, I'd just blanket set observedGeneration of all pod conditions... not the right thing' for resize conditions.
Server-side mitigation for old 0.26.0-0.26.3 clients; #116603 (client fix) is xref background, not defect source.
Fixes pre-existing wrong comments/code on items/queue invariant (#91709); #91435 cited only for late wording discussion.
Handles a different case (deleted UDP services), mirroring #139629's approach; no defect from first PR.
'In #123393 I made some changes... KUBE_TIMEOUT is not exported'; re-adds it explicitly in test-integration.sh.
'#138567 modified the log line' constructing ObjectRef, causing data race; second PR fixes it in scheduling_queue.go.
verify-file-sizes.sh added by #121549 fails on macOS; second PR (kind/bug, Fixes #124155) fixes the script.
'previous attempt at fixing this fails to detect' error on older servers; kind/regression, repairs Cause check added by #92537.
First PR explicitly excluded CPU manager updates; second fills a feature gap in untouched cpumanager code, not citing #116429 as cause.
Fixes review issue in #70876's test: patch modified immutable node name, blocking #70886; edits idempotency_test.go.
Follow-up cleanup making FakeRuntime asserts fail tests; fixes pre-existing issue #98937, not a defect from #98956.
Rejects overflow/negative bounds that predate #139698; first PR's step guard cited as context, not defect source.
Removes flaky tag, citing #113562 as the fix; no defect repaired.
'API removed in ... #88568', 'API moved without updating test'; second PR fixes failing ResourceMetricsAPI e2e test.
'In #101207 we updated permissions... but did not account for cluster upgrades'; changes chown to chown -R in same lines.
'#78245... changed pre-existing test to use a loop. This caused the flake from #86179'; splits tests.
Follow-up from #97877 review discussion adding podNamespace for inline volumes; inline namespace translation unresolved before, not clearly introduced.
After #87012 passed KUBE_BUILD_PLATFORMS, make release failed at tarball step (comment on #87012); second PR fixes release.sh.
